rules.rule: Skills live only under skills/. Never add or commit .agents/skills/ or .claude/skills/ in this repository; runtime copies are created only while installing into a target repository.

Every directory under skills/ must contain SKILL.md and be listed in at least one bundle in skills/manifest.json. A skill added, renamed, or removed without the matching manifest.json change must be flagged.
PRODUCT.md and DESIGN.md must exist only directly under docs/. Flag any PRODUCT.md or DESIGN.md at the repository root or under .agents/context/, because it silently takes precedence over docs/.

A new durable artifact namespace under docs/ must be indexed in docs/README.md and provide its own local README.md contract before it contains artifacts. Do not treat docs/PRODUCT.md as product authority; durable product rules belong in docs/product/, accepted project vocabulary belongs in docs/glossary/, and decisions belong in docs/decisions/. Do not add a second decision system such as docs/adr/.
In Markdown files under docs/ and skills/, each complete sentence should be on its own line. Flag newly added paragraphs that put several sentences on one line.

cli.js and lib/** must run on Node >=14, the engines.node value in package.json. Flag newer syntax or APIs such as ??=, ||=, Array.prototype.at, Object.hasOwn, structuredClone, or the node: import prefix.

Installer and update code must not overwrite or delete files in the target repository that the user may have customized without an explicit managed-file check. Flag writes or removals that bypass lib/managed-files.js or ignore existing files.
If a new top-level file or directory must ship to users, it must be added to the files array in package.json; otherwise it will be missing from the installed package.

GitHub Actions workflows must declare top-level permissions with the minimum scope (default contents: read), set persist-credentials: false on actions/checkout unless the job pushes, and must not use pull_request_target with a checkout of PR code.
